fieldNotes.siteResolution: Given coords (32.6949,-96.9470) were ~1.6km NE in open land. Google geocode of 4718 Mountain Creek Pkwy, Dallas TX 75236 returned 32.6852,-96.9618, landing on a large industrial building in the Mountain Creek Business Park. Confirmed as the Primo/BlueTriton (Ozarka) Dallas bottling plant by the presence of water silos/tanks, process equipment and a steam plume at the NE (z19 ne-struct crop) plus an active dock bank and large trailer drop yard - consistent with a bottling/distribution plant. Locked center ~32.6855,-96.9615.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth visible at the building's road frontage or yard access. The west front faces Mountain Creek Pkwy set well back behind a landscaped berm and trees with open employee-parking driveways (Street View pano 3MsqlSE1qXQMBYP8brGOEA, 2025-01 - no gate). The truck docks and drop yard are on the open east/NE side with no perimeter fence visible in satellite. FALSE (medium confidence - a yard-side gate could exist out of frame).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth-sized structure at any entrance. The small structures at the NE are process/utility/office buildings, not a gate booth beside a controlled lane. FALSE.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock bank on the building's EAST face running most of the building length (z19 east-docks crop, trailers backed in, ~30-40 dock positions visible). Honest estimate ~40 -> banded 25-50 (conservative; could reach 50+). Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: The main dock activity is concentrated on the east face; no clearly distinct second ship/receive bank on a different face confirmed (the NE has a process/canopy area, not an obvious second dock bank). FALSE, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer drop yard fills the entire east of the property: many parallel rows of trailers parked without tractors (z18 east-yard + z19 crops show 50+). Banded 50+. dropYard TRUE.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - dedicated multi-row trailer-storage lot east of the building, distinct from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved aprons and a long internal yard loop from the SW entrance around to the east docks/yard easily hold 3+ trucks -> drivewayLong TRUE, postGateStaging TRUE (large internal paved holding).
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Primary site access is the SW driveway off Mountain Creek Pkwy serving both parking and the truck loop to the east yard; same in/out point -> entryExitTogether TRUE.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the east boundary is open grass and a drainage line, not rail. FALSE.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~30-40 at east docks + ~50+ in east drop rows = ~90. Approximate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Drop-yard rows + dock positions could hold ~140 trailers at full pack.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~38 acres for the building footprint + east drop yard + north process area, derived from the perimeter polygon.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large contiguous bottling/warehouse building (with attached process/tank area at the NE). Counted as 1.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the City of Dallas (SW Dallas / Mountain Creek), a developed metro industrial park with many adjacent big-box warehouses -> Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad clearly visible in the truck path. FALSE.
fieldNotes.imageryQuality: Clear recent Maxar/Airbus/Vexcel tiles + 2025-01 Street View on Mountain Creek Pkwy. The business park has many similar buildings; the Primo building was confirmed by the tanks/silos/steam signature at the NE. Dock count banded conservatively.
